summary: Iteration 5 RE-VALIDATION after iter-4 fixes. Backend: 33/33 pytest PASS — added new TestOcrExtract::test_bogus_1x1_png_returns_400_not_500 verifying litellm BadRequestError now correctly maps to HTTP 400 (was 500 in iter-4). All regression suites green: 10 PIN security + 20 PAYO API + 3 OCR. Frontend: ALL critical iter-4 wiring bugs are FIXED — Transfer no longer red-screens (params is correctly destructured via useLocalSearchParams), Settings AI Engine card renders at the top with badge 'CLOUD' and message containing 'Cloud Fallback (Whisper + GPT-4o-mini)', and the security row label is now 'Keamanan PIN' and tapping it correctly navigates to /setup-pin. Verified end-to-end on the live preview URL: dashboard 9020.21 USDT renders → Settings tab shows AI card + Keamanan PIN row → tap navigates to /setup-pin → Scan QRIS shows both demo buttons → Demo:QR pre-fills address=TXYZ1aBcDeFg2hIjKlMnOpQ3rStUvWxY + amount=50 → tap Kirim → PIN modal → enter 123456 → SuccessModal '50 USDT · Terkirim ke TXYZ1aBcDeFg…vWxY' → Demo:OCR pre-fills address=TLmNoPq4RsTuVwXy5zAbCdEfGhIjKlMn → Open QRIS overlay opens with QR code. IMPORTANT NOTE: needed to `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` once because Metro had cached the broken iter-4 bundle and was still serving 'params is not defined' even though the source file on disk already had the fix; after restart the new bundle compiled cleanly and all flows pass. One MINOR functional miss remains: note prefill 'Dari Scan QR / OCR' is empty — scan-qris.tsx handleAddress() builds the query string {address, amount} but never adds from=scan, so transfer.tsx's `if (params.from === 'scan') setNote(...)` branch never fires. Address+amount prefill works; only the note field stays empty.

minor.issue: (Carryover) hardcoded fallback total_usdt=9020.21/count=5 when no IN tx today.

rca_of_issue: Iter-4's 3 frontend bugs were genuinely fixed in source, but Metro's CI-mode bundle cache served the OLD broken bundle on first probe — testing agent saw the same red-screen + missing AI card + 'Keamanan' label as iter-4 and almost re-reported the bugs as unfixed. Restarting expo via supervisorctl forced a fresh bundle and ALL three issues were demonstrably resolved. Lesson: when a main agent claims a frontend wiring fix, always `supervisorctl restart expo` once before re-testing or you'll get false negatives from Metro cache. The single remaining gap (empty note field on scan→transfer) is a 1-line fix in scan-qris.tsx handleAddress() — author added the `from=scan` consumer in transfer.tsx but forgot to add the producer in scan-qris.tsx. Mechanical, no business-logic dispute.
